what: NOWCAST_ERA_1. The expectations committed to at this endpoint, with the current state they were reasoned from.
observationLag: the latest mature quarter is 1446Q1, approximately 2024-07-08G. Every statement here is CURRENT-AS-PUBLISHED, not current-as-decided, and the gap between the two is not measurable because no publication date exists per judgment.

currentStateAtFreeze.traceabilityDefinition: share of court non-statutory mentions whose canonical identity is a named jurist, book, maxim text or hadith collection. Generic classes and unresolved raw strings are not traceable.

SIX_MONTH.target: share of the current top-50 court articles still in the top-50 two mature quarters later
SIX_MONTH.scoringRule: compare the realised hold rate at the second mature quarter after 1446Q1 against this value; the forecast is wrong if it misses by more than 0.10.
SIX_MONTH.regimeAssumption: no material detected regime break before target maturity, per REGIME_DETECTOR_ERA_1

TWELVE_MONTH.target: which articles outside the current top-50 enter it
TWELVE_MONTH.probabilities: NONE. RANK_ONLY, as the forecasting programme already established: fold-to-fold precision varies too widely for a calibrated number.
TWELVE_MONTH.regimeAssumption: no material detected regime break before target maturity

TWENTY_FOUR_MONTH.why: the corpus holds ten mature quarters. A 24-month horizon is eight of them, so a backtest would have at most two non-overlapping folds. Temporal depth does not justify the horizon and no forecast is issued at it.

issuedForecasts.baseline: persistence. Nothing in this repository has beaten it and nothing here claims to.

retrievalArchitectures.design: pseudo-future. Each architecture is built on history up to a fold and scored on the next mature quarter's court citations. Historical folds are calibration only.

STATUTE_ONLY.indexSizeProxy: not comparable across architectures; coverage is reported without a size penalty and must be read with that in mind

STATUTE_PLUS_CURRENT_ARTICLE_ECOLOGY.indexSizeProxy: not comparable across architectures; coverage is reported without a size penalty and must be read with that in mind

STATUTE_PLUS_DOCTRINAL_COMPANIONS.indexSizeProxy: not comparable across architectures; coverage is reported without a size penalty and must be read with that in mind

SPEAKER_AWARE_HYBRID.indexSizeProxy: not comparable across architectures; coverage is reported without a size penalty and must be read with that in mind

TIME_AWARE_RECENT_WINDOW.indexSizeProxy: not comparable across architectures; coverage is reported without a size penalty and must be read with that in mind

retrievalArchitectures.reading: coverage alone favours whichever index is largest, so the column that matters is DRIFT: how much coverage an architecture loses as the law moves under it. A time-aware index that keeps coverage while staying small is the one that protects against future staleness.

branches.name: CURRENT_CONDITIONS_CONTINUE
branches.expect_first: nothing outside the frozen detector bounds
branches.falsifier: any REGIME_CANDIDATE or confirmed detector shift
branches.data_needed: none; this is the default and it wins by default

branches.name: MAJOR_NEW_LAW_OR_REGULATORY_PACKAGE
branches.expect_first: court statutory visibility of the new instrument in the first mature quarter at or after its commencement
branches.falsifier: commencement passes and the instrument stays absent for three mature quarters
branches.data_needed: a verified commencement date, which the legal clock layer now produces

branches.name: VERIFIED_BAR_LEGAL_AI_ADOPTION
branches.expect_first: party-side long-tail statutory use and party source diversity
metrics: formula concentration in the bar's voice
branches.falsifier: verified bar adoption with party-side breadth inside its historical bounds while the court's moves
branches.data_needed: an adoption event at L3_WORKFLOW_MATCH, of which there are currently none

branches.name: VERIFIED_BENCH_JUDICIAL_RESEARCH_AI
branches.falsifier: verified bench adoption and only statutory ranking moves
branches.data_needed: the same linkability, in the observed forum

branches.name: AI_BECOMES_A_MATERIAL_SUBJECT_OF_LITIGATION
branches.falsifier: none needed; this branch is observed or it is not

branches.name: PUBLICATION_OR_DATA_ACCESS_CHANGE
branches.expect_first: the publication and docket families, which are already the least stationary part of the corpus
branches.falsifier: an access change with the publication family inside its bounds
branches.data_needed: none; this branch is the one the corpus is best able to see, and least able to distinguish from legal change

branches.name: MAJOR_INSTITUTIONAL_RESTRUCTURING
branches.data_needed: an official restructuring event, of which the bounded lookup found none in the observed window

hypotheses.name: HOMOGENISATION
hypotheses.falsifier: verified adoption with concentration flat or falling

hypotheses.name: DISCOVERY
hypotheses.falsifier: verified adoption with the long tail flat or shrinking

hypotheses.name: TRACEABILITY
hypotheses.claim: AI increases named and retrievable authority
metrics: named-identity share of court non-statutory mentions
hypotheses.falsifier: verified adoption with the named share flat or falling

hypotheses.name: GENERIC_DRAFTING
hypotheses.falsifier: verified adoption with the generic share flat or falling

hypotheses.name: NO_MATERIAL_CHANGE
hypotheses.falsifier: any confirmed shift in an expected layer
hypotheses.note: this is the default and it wins by default

hypotheses.name: CHANNEL_DEPENDENT
hypotheses.claim: bar AI and bench AI produce different changes
metrics: every metric above, split by voice
hypotheses.falsifier: both channels adopted and the voice split shows the same movement
hypotheses.required_linkability: two separately verified events, one per channel

hypothesisTournament.allRequire: an adoption event at L3_WORKFLOW_MATCH, of which the registry holds none

aiAnchors.quote_ar: يجوز الاستعانة بالتقنيات الحديثة في إجراءات الإثبات، بما في ذلك الذكاء الاصطناعي، ويُستغنى عن أي إجراء تحققت غايته باستخدام هذه التقنيات.
aiAnchors.what_it_anchors: AI as a TOOL OF THE EVIDENTIARY PROCESS
aiAnchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: AI as a source of liability, as an author, or as a subject of a claim

aiAnchors.quote_ar: يجوز الاستفادة من تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي في الإجراءات الإلكترونية، ويستغنى عن أي إجراء تحققت غايته باستخدام تلك التقنية.
aiAnchors.what_it_anchors: AI as a TOOL OF COMMERCIAL COURT PROCEDURE, in the instrument governing the forum this corpus observes

aiAnchors.quote_ar: وللوكالة استخدام تقنيات الذكاء الاصطناعي للقيام بخدمات التنفيذ.
aiAnchors.what_it_anchors: AI in the delivery of enforcement services
aiAnchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: liability for an AI-delivered enforcement act

aiAnchors.quote_ar: يستفاد من التقنيات الحديثة والذكاء الاصطناعي في إجراءات التوثيق، ويستغنى عن أي إجراء تحققت غايته باستخدام تلك التقنيات.
aiAnchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: the validity consequences of an AI-assisted notarial act

aiAnchors.quote_ar: يشمل الدليل الرقمي الآتي: 1. السجل الرقمي. 2. المحرَّر الرقمي. 3. التوقيع الرقمي. 4. المراسلات الرقمية بما فيها البريد الرقمي. 5. وسائل الاتصال. 6. الوسائط الرقمية. 7. أي دليل رقمي آخر.
aiAnchors.what_it_anchors: the category into which AI-generated or AI-manipulated material would arrive as EVIDENCE. Item 7 is open-ended on its own terms.
aiAnchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: authenticity of synthetic material, which the text does not address in these words

aiAnchors.quote_ar: يجوز اعتبار الدليل الإلكتروني حجة في الإثبات، على أن تتضمن اللائحة وسائل التحقق من الدليل الإلكتروني وإجراءات تقديمه.
aiAnchors.what_it_anchors: admissibility of electronic evidence in the observed forum, with verification delegated to the regulation
aiAnchors.what_it_does_not_anchor: a verification standard for synthetic media

aiAnchors.instrument: الترتيبات التنظيمية للهيئة السعودية للبيانات والذكاء الاصطناعي
aiAnchors.quote_ar: تكون الهيئة الجهة المختصة في المملكة بالبيانات (بما في ذلك البيانات الضخمة) والذكاء الاصطناعي، والمرجع الوطني في كل ما يتعلق بهما من تنظيم وتطوير وتعامل
aiAnchors.what_it_anchors: the REGULATORY competence for AI, which is an authority and not a court

aiIssueFamilies.LIKELY_LEGAL_ENTRY_POINT: administrative-law review, the Board of Grievances' forum

aiIssueFamilies.FIRST_OBSERVABLE_SIGNAL: a service-failure claim where performance was autonomous

firstCaseReadiness.what: FIRST-AI-CASE READINESS. The capture schema is defined BEFORE the first validated AI-material dispute appears, so the first one is recorded against a fixed template rather than described after the fact.
firstCaseReadiness.trigger: a judgment in this corpus in which an AI system is material to the dispute, not merely mentioned. Materiality is decided by the AI radar's existing L3 rule, which currently returns zero.
capture_fields: ai_issue_family (from the emerging AI law map)
new_doctrinal_source (identity not previously in the canon)
forbidden: inferring AI involvement from writing style
treating a mention of AI as an AI-material dispute
predicting the outcome of the case
naming a judge, a party or a firm
firstCaseReadiness.baseline_at_definition: zero AI-material disputes in the observed corpus. The schema is armed against a base rate of zero, which is the point.

aiComponents.noSingleScore: no AI readiness index is computed. A single number would hide which component moved, and we do not yet know which components matter.

litigation_observability.evidence: no AI-material dispute in the corpus

statutory_anchor_availability.evidence: four explicit permission articles, no substantive liability rule in the texts held

evidence_complexity.evidence: ANCH-EVID-54 item 7 and ANCH-CCL-55's delegation of verification means

liability_ambiguity.evidence: no liability-allocation wording for autonomous acts in the instruments this repository holds

institutional_ai_adoption.evidence: seven adoption events, none at L3_WORKFLOW_MATCH

court_data_observability.evidence: the latest mature quarter is roughly two years behind the session clock and no publication date exists per judgment

aiBaseline.reading: Saudi law already permits AI in the procedures of the very forum this corpus observes, while the corpus contains no dispute in which AI is material. Permission is present; consequence is untested.

liveChain.what: LIVE LEGAL CHANGE CHAIN. From this commit onward, an event captured PROSPECTIVELY records milestones as they occur.
liveChain.orderingIsNotRequired: the milestones are stored, not sequenced. The transition programme already showed that an apparent ordering can be an artefact of when the clock was started.
liveChain.captureClass: computed from recorded_at against the event's observable_from, never declared. An event recorded after its observable_from is BACKFILLED and can never be reported as foresight.
liveChain.why: every event this repository holds was recorded after the fact. The chain starts empty on purpose, and that is the point of defining it now.

surpriseReadiness.what: UNKNOWN-UNKNOWN WATCH. The project must be able to discover a future it did not name.
surpriseReadiness.rule: any recurring legal concept, statutory instrument or non-statutory identity that is NOT in a known family and that crosses the support threshold used elsewhere in this repository -- observed in at least ten judgments, in at least two mature quarters -- opens a SURPRISE_LEDGER entry.
appliesTo: instrument track ids not previously court-cited
canonical non-statutory identities outside the 28-identity canon, which currently surface as RAW strings
authority-adjacent formula classes not in the mechanical taxonomy
surpriseReadiness.discipline: the entry is opened FIRST and the explanation is searched for afterwards. An entry with no explanation stays UNKNOWN, and resemblance to an expectation is never evidence.

scoringDiscipline: a forecast here is scored against the realised value at its stated horizon, under the regime assumption recorded with it. A regime break does not excuse a miss; it changes the status to REGIME_BREAK_BEFORE_TARGET, and that status is set by the frozen regime detector, not by the outcome.
whatThisDoesNotTouch: every earlier frozen era stands: the doctrinal diffusion baseline, the formula baseline, the three-layer baseline, the legal clock era and the regime detector era, along with all three detector eras.
whatWouldMoveThis: nothing. A later endpoint gets NOWCAST_ERA_2 and this file remains what was expected here.
